input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text or /moves/knight_g8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys excluding the moving piece's own key, and must also be co-signed by rook_h8 and at least one other agent, so the pieces that keep going off plan with greed or amnesia cannot get a move accepted without near-unanimous agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false)
